market_outlook.short_term: Risk-on bias continues into U.S.-China summit; oil likely to test lower on Iran diplomacy; equities near records but AI rotation underway; crypto volatile above $85K; watch for consumer data prints that may contradict equity strength. 1-3 month: moderate upside with elevated volatility around summit.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle supports tech leadership but rotation to application layer and infrastructure (data centres, chips) will define winners. Obesity drug market expands to $100B+ by 2030. Energy transition accelerates (80% renewables in Australia). Consumer spending remains the key vulnerability. U.S. fiscal trajectory (Pickering warning) creates long-term bond supply risk. 6-12 month: constructive but uneven; favor quality and infrastructure over speculative growth.
